summary: Parents say shutting off comment after half an hour was not good faith.
realLife: At a school board meeting dozens of parents filled overflow rooms, comment was cut after thirty minutes, and a parent said more time would have shown good faith.
sources: CBS Minnesota, St. Paul parents fighting plan to close schools: https://www.cbsnews.com/amp/minnesota/news/st-paul-school-board-meeting-closing-schools
